messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Good news — settled at a total termination payment of £115,000 (£30,000 taxable + £85,000 compensation, first £30k tax-free), well within your £120,000 authority, plus the £1,500 + VAT costs contribution and the agreed reference. Drafting the agreement now; we expect signature within the week.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP
